description: Consolidated who-does-what for the DoD/DON civilian personnel-action-to-pay lifecycle, grounded in DCPDS UM, DCPS UM, and the governing CIVPAY authorities. AUTHORITY PRECEDENCE (a lower tier implements but never overrides a higher one): Tier 1 Federal = OPM (5 U.S.C., 5 CFR, OPM GPPA); Tier 2 DoD/overseas = DoD FMR Vol 8, DoDI 1400.25, DSSR; Tier 3 Systems = DCPDS UM, DCPS UM/Interface Spec; Tier 4 Component = DON/OCHR instructions & roles. Each row separates the GoverningAuthority (the rule's source, Tier 1-2) from the LocalProcedure/System (how it is executed, Tier 3-4).

columns.name: ReferenceLink
columns.description: Link to the governing reference, report, or audit (public URL where one exists; internal manual/report citation otherwise).

notes: Provision the List with the columns above, then import data/civpay_dol.csv. The precedence rule is enforced editorially: GoverningAuthority always names a Tier 1-2 source; DON/system references go in LocalProcedure, never as the governing authority. Reuses the CIVPAY Q&A search web part pattern (sharepoint/dol-search-webpart.html) for a searchable view.
